headline: Callahan's Passage Reawakens as Weathered Expanse Keeps Busiest Front
war_summary: Since our last edition, Callahan's Passage has burst back into the ledger: ten base actions in the day's count, three posts taken by Colonial forces and one by Warden arms, with the latest hour's returns running near eight hundred casualties on each side. The Weathered Expanse still leads all fronts at thirty-nine actions, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance hardest pressed, its twenty-four-hour losses reckoned at twelve thousand Colonial and better than seventeen thousand Warden. The Stlican Shelf keeps churning about Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, twenty-seven actions to its credit, and the Nevish Line stays warm at seventeen, Blackcoat Way again the busiest post. Palantine Berm filed the freshest dispatch of any front at the press hour, the Pippeli Stones its storm-centre, its casualty rate climbing more than fourfold within the hour. Kuura Strand continues to boil about Talven, and Mooring County records fresh movement at The Wind Hills. Stonecradle and the Linn of Mercy have logged no base events since morning, though Stonecradle's casualty figures climb anew. It is day 461; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
